items.title: Anthropic and 'Grand Theft Auto VI' launched on the same day. The video game trade is winning for now.

items.title: Wedbush kept this gaming stock on its Best Ideas List after its most recent launch
items.summary: Investing.com -- Wedbush analyst Alicia Reese has reiterated an Outperform rating on Take-Two Interactive Software Inc (NASDAQ:TTWO) and raised her price target to $295 from $280, keeping the stock on the firm's Best Ideas List following the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI.
